notes: Rule 3 sanity check passed: genuine, live, operational Spanish design-furniture DTC brand (PrestaShop-based platform, 9 country storefronts es/uk/fr/it/pt/de/ie/nl/pl, active careers subdomain empleo.sklum.com, Trustpilot review link present, robots.txt is a normal PrestaShop-generated file referencing real internal CMS controllers), no closing-down-sale language anywhere. robots.txt checked: no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow, so no WAF-bypass ethics issue. Access route: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/interstitial encountered (curl_cffi default profile via probe.py sufficed for every page fetched). Category discovery: no PrestaShop-standard sitemap category listing was usable (sitemap only lists a general product+category mixed feed), so the taxonomy was built by (1) extracting all distinct '-comprar-' category URLs from the 159k-line es sitemap (354 unique candidates), then (2) walking each relevant branch's own on-page navigation menu (a JS-rendered category tab strip that IS present in server-rendered HTML) to recover true parent/child relationships via breadcrumb and nav-link co-occurrence. Qty verification (Rule 1): every leaf page embeds a client-side 'searchConfiguration' JSON with a 'total' field, which is the exact same number rendered in the visible header "N productos en " and again in the 'Has visto 50 productos de N' load-more caption -- i.e. the number appears independently in two places on the same rendered page (JSON state + two separate DOM text nodes). Empirically cross-checked the exhaustion condition ceil(total/pageSize) == the page's own 'pages' field (pageSize is a stable defaultResultsPerPage:50 sitewide) on two categories of very different size: Iluminacion total=573, pages=12 (ceil(573/50)=12, exact match) and Lamparas para mesitas de noche total=122, pages=3 (ceil(122/50)=3, exact match). This mechanism was then used as the qty source for every row below (evidence quotes the rendered header text for each). No inflation pattern (Shopify/Magento/Constructor.io style) applies to this platform; this is a first-seen count mechanism for the project, verified exact under the standard exhaustion check both times it was tested. RULE 0 gains: included Bathroom Mirrors (Espejos de bano, 27), Bathroom Wall/Ceiling Lighting (Apliques para bano 35 + Lamparas de techo para bano 5, both children of Iluminacion para el bano), Kids Lighting (Iluminacion infantil, 21), Bedroom Wall Lighting (Apliques de dormitorio, 27), Dining Room Lamps (106), Bedside Table Lamps (122), Office Lamps (52), Entryway Mirrors (Espejos recibidor, 28), and a full 6-node Outdoor/Garden Lighting branch (Outdoor Ceiling/Floor/Wall/Bollard/String/Solar, 14+42+56+26+9+25) under 'Iluminacion de jardin' -- every one of these would have been wrongly dropped by a room-word exclusion. Documented Rule 0.6 overlaps: Apliques de dormitorio (Bedroom Wall Lighting, 27) is a room-specific subset of the general Wall Lighting node (Apliques de pared, 81) -- both kept as genuine separate nav branches per the site's own taxonomy. Mixed roll-ups DROPPED (inspected actual product titles per rule, all confirmed mixed populations already covered by their type-specific siblings, not padded): 'Decoracion de salon' (223, Living Room Decor -- sample titles showed mirrors+vases+candle holders+paintings+artificial flowers+curtains all pooled), 'Decoracion habitacion' (117, Any-Room Decor -- cushions+mirrors+rugs+curtains+poufs+coat racks+dried branches+frames pooled), 'Decoracion de jardin' aka 'Decoracion de exterior' (232, Garden Decor -- wall lights+planters+umbrella stands+storage trunks+umbrellas+outdoor rugs+cushions+vases+torches pooled), 'Decoracion de oficina y despacho' (131 -- organizers+lamps+frames+bookends+desk clocks+cable organizers+laptop stands+trash cans+paintings+artificial plants pooled), 'Decoracion infantil' (44, Kids Decor -- rugs+wall lights+canvas art+canopies+cushions+string lights+knobs+coat racks+tapestries+mirrors pooled), 'Accesorios de mesa' (73, Table Accessories -- copas+vasos+jarras+tazas+placemats+trivets+cruets+napkins+coasters+cocktail-bar-tools pooled, i.e. a superset of Copas/Vasos/Jarras/Tazas already counted plus excluded textile/bar-tool items), 'Iluminacion restaurante/hosteleria' (199) and 'Decoracion de bares' (business-vertical cross-sections spanning the entire ceiling/wall/table/floor lamp catalogue for hospitality use-cases, not a home-decor room). Facet/material re-cuts DROPPED (compared product-ID sets, confirmed 100% or near-100% containment in the canonical type node, so keeping only the canonical node): 'Jarrones de ceramica' (31, material subset of Jarrones 73), 'Vasos de cristal' (14990, 6 products) confirmed identical product slugs to 6 of the 16 items already in the broader 'Vasos' (13035, 16) -- kept Vasos, dropped Vasos de cristal; 'Vajilla blanca/negra/de gres' and 'Cuberteria dorada/negra' (colour/material facets of Vajilla/Cuberteria); 'Cuadros de madera/de tela/blancos' (material/colour facets of Cuadros decorativos); 'Espejos redondos/de madera/ventana/ovalados/dorados/irregulares/grandes dorados' (shape/material/colour facets of the mirror type nodes). 'Lamparas de exterior' (3607, 91) treated as a mid-tier aggregate umbrella and dropped in favour of its more specific children (Outdoor Ceiling/Floor/Wall Lamps) to avoid double-counting. 'Guirnaldas y Neones' (855, 30) confirmed as a near-total subset of the larger 'Iluminacion decorativa' (853, 44, string/fairy lights, LED garlands, star lights, neon signs, light curtains) -- kept the larger encompassing node, dropped the subset; flagged that both nodes contain a small minority (~2 of 20 sampled) of explicitly Christmas-labelled items (corona de navidad, arbol de navidad led) mixed in with year-round decorative string lighting -- given the low contamination ratio this was kept as a legitimate lighting category rather than dropped outright, unlike the majority-scented-candle precedent. Velas (Candles, 12277, 10 products) inspected: all sampled titles are 'vela decorativa en ceramica' with no scent/fragrance language (no aroma/perfumada/aromatica) -- kept as decorative unscented candles. Excluded categories (holiday: Navidad/Decoracion de navidad/Luz de navidad/Vajilla navidad/Cuberteria navidad/Arboles de navidad/Adornos arbol navidad/Coronas de navidad/Guirnaldas de navidad; artificial/dried botanicals: Plantas artificiales/Flores artificiales/Ramas y flores secas; furniture and storage: Biombos, Escaleras decorativas, Revisteros, Cestos y cajas, Cajas, Joyeros, Tiradores y pomos, Estanterias de pared, Botelleros (its own page title literally read 'Muebles de pared y suelo para vino' -- wine furniture); textiles: Alfombras, Cojines, Cortinas, Mantas, Ropa de cama, Textil de bano, Manteleria, Servilletas, Manteles, Tapiceria; kitchen tools/flatware/bar: Cuberteria, Utensilios de cocina, Tablas de cocina, Escurreplatos, Salvamanteles, Organizadores de cocina, Delantales, Grifos de cocina, Pajitas reutilizables, Coctelera/Cubitera/Pinzas para hielo; bathroom hardware/fixtures per Rule 0.4 (kept only bathroom mirrors and bathroom lighting): Jaboneras, Dispensadores de jabon, Portacepillos, Toalleros, Papeleras de bano, Perchas para bano, Portarrollos de bano, Escobillas de bano, Sets de bano, Lavabos, Grifos, Duchas, Mamparas, Inodoros, Muebles de bano; light bulbs (Bombillas E27/E14/G9/vintage), lamp parts/wiring (Accesorios lamparas, Bases para lamparas, Cables para lamparas, Downlights accesorios); sale/new-arrival/collection/bundle pages (Rebajas *, Novedades *, Packs *, Invisible Light design collection). Packs iluminacion/Packs decoracion excluded as bundle facets, not standing categories.
